summary.text: Joe McDonald is a Republican state representative from Minnesota House District 29A who has served since 2011 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
Ballotpedia lists his professional experience as owning a photography studio.

paragraphs.text: Joe McDonald earned an A.A. in photography from Hennepin Technical College, a master's degree in photography in 2003, and a craftsman degree in 2008.
Ballotpedia says his professional experience includes owning a photography studio.
McDonald assumed office in the Minnesota House in 2011.
In the 2025-2026 session he was assigned to the Children and Families Finance and Policy, Elections Finance and Policy, and Legacy Finance committees, and he co-chairs the Legacy Finance Committee.
The Republican primary for his seat on August 11, 2026, was canceled.
